description: Repository config for laurigates/.github. The owner-wide Renovate runner supplies everything else; this file adds tracking of two kinds of workflow_call input default: the Claude model IDs (#135) and the plugins-ref commits of laurigates/claude-plugins (#109).

It also tracks the release binaries four reusable workflows download at a pinned <TOOL>_VERSION (#166): gitleaks, osv-scanner, opencode and ruff, each through the github-releases datasource. The <TOOL>_SHA256 beside each version is not tracked, so the checksum is replaced by hand on each bump PR before it merges. The gitleaks and osv-scanner PRs fail their checksum check until then and the ruff PR fails ruff-advisory's fixture check, but the opencode PR is green, because no test here downloads the real opencode release (CLAUDE.md, tool-pins entry).

The Claude model lookup needs the runner to pass ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to reusable-renovate.yml, which then authenticates api.anthropic.com; the key must be scoped to one workspace (see the secret's description there). Without it the lookup fails and the pins are not updated; nothing else changes.

extends and ignoreDeps (#154): the preset makes Renovate write and bump GitHub Action pins as a commit SHA with a version comment, and laurigates/.github is ignored because the preset would otherwise pin this repository's own @main references to main's head.

customManagers.description: Claude model IDs pinned as workflow_call input defaults, e.g. default: 'claude-opus-5-5'. Dated snapshot IDs and prose mentions are not matched.

The plugins-ref input defaults: the laurigates/claude-plugins commit whose git-plugin script reusable-merge-method.yml and reusable-issue-labels.yml run (#109). git-refs follows the head of main, so every claude-plugins commit is a candidate, not only changes to those scripts.

GITLEAKS_VERSION in reusable-security-secrets.yml (#166): the gitleaks/gitleaks release binary the step downloads and checks against GITLEAKS_SHA256. Release tags are vX.Y.Z. Renovate cannot write the new GITLEAKS_SHA256, so the bump PR fails its checksum check until the hash is edited on it.

OSV_SCANNER_VERSION in reusable-security-deps.yml (#166): the google/osv-scanner release binary the step downloads and checks against OSV_SCANNER_SHA256. Release tags are vX.Y.Z. Renovate cannot write the new OSV_SCANNER_SHA256, so the bump PR fails its checksum check until the hash is edited on it.

OPENCODE_VERSION in reusable-opencode-review.yml (#166): the anomalyco/opencode release binary the step downloads and checks against OPENCODE_SHA256. Release tags are vX.Y.Z. Renovate cannot write the new OPENCODE_SHA256, and no test here downloads the real release (opencode-review installs a stub tarball with its own hash), so the bump PR is green with the old hash: replace OPENCODE_SHA256 on it before merging, or the review fails at install in every caller.

RUFF_VERSION in reusable-quality-code-smell.yml (#166): the astral-sh/ruff release tarball the step downloads and checks against RUFF_SHA256. Release tags are X.Y.Z, with no v. Renovate cannot write the new RUFF_SHA256, and no test here downloads the real tarball; the bump PR is red because ruff-advisory requires the fixture's ruff_version to equal RUFF_VERSION. Replace RUFF_SHA256 on it before merging, then re-run .github/tests/ruff-advisory/gen.sh on the new tarball, which checks it against RUFF_SHA256 and regenerates the fixture.

claude-models.description: GET https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models (active and deprecated models). The per-line regex versioning above drops other model lines and dated snapshot IDs.

packageRules.description: A model change alters review behaviour and cost for every caller, so it gets its own PR instead of riding in a grouped dependency update.

The plugins-ref pins move with every claude-plugins commit, so they get one PR a week of their own. Saturday falls inside the runner's weekend branch-creation window. A bump still needs a read of what the workflow steps parse from the script's output.
